question: In despair because of the perpetuation of untouchability in Hindu doctrine, BR Ambedkar converted to _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Buddhism:**

 
 
• B.R. Ambedkar converted to Buddhism on October 14, 1956, in Nagpur, India.
 
• He saw Buddhism as a religion that rejected the caste system and promoted equality.
 
• He believed that Buddhism offered a path to liberation from the oppressive Hindu caste structure.
 
• His conversion was accompanied by a mass conversion of his followers, primarily Dalits.
 
• He wrote "The Buddha and His Dhamma," which presented his interpretation of Buddhist teachings.
